summary: URL shortener API with aliases, expiry, click statistics, link previews and an admin delete endpoint.

defects.title: Short codes derived from Math.random
defects.description: generateCode() builds codes from Math.random(), a non-cryptographic PRNG whose output is predictable, so private links can be enumerated or predicted.
defects.trigger: Call generateCode() with Math.random pinned to a fixed value
defects.observed: The code is a pure function of Math.random(): the same value yields the same code.

defects.title: New links silently overwrite existing codes
defects.description: createLink() stores the link without checking whether the code (alias or generated) already exists, so anyone can repoint an existing short link.
defects.observed: Second request returns 201 and /r/docs now redirects to the second url.

defects.title: Any URL scheme accepted as a redirect target
defects.description: validateTarget() only checks that the string parses as a URL, so javascript:, data: and file: targets are stored and served in the Location header.

defects.title: Click counter loses concurrent updates
defects.description: recordClick() reads link.clicks, awaits the log append, then writes the stale value + 1; concurrent redirects overwrite each other's increments.
defects.observed: All 200 redirects succeed but stats report far fewer clicks.

defects.title: Clicks per day divides by zero on the creation day
defects.description: clicksPerDay() divides by the number of full days since creation, which is 0 for the first 24 hours; the Infinity/NaN result is serialised as null.
defects.trigger: Create a link, click it once, GET /stats/:code

defects.title: Admin endpoint guarded by a hardcoded token
defects.description: handleAdminDelete() authorises anyone whose X-Admin header equals a constant compiled into the source.
defects.trigger: POST /admin/delete with X-Admin set to the constant from server.ts

defects.title: Aliases lowercased on creation but looked up verbatim
defects.description: normalizeAlias() stores aliases in lower case, but resolveLink() looks the code up exactly as requested, so the alias a user chose does not resolve.

defects.title: Eight-character aliases are truncated to seven
defects.description: validateAlias() accepts aliases up to MAX_ALIAS_LENGTH (8) characters, but normalizeAlias() slices to CODE_LENGTH (7), so a valid 8-character alias is silently shortened.

defects.title: Expired links keep resolving (seconds vs milliseconds)
defects.description: createLink() stores expiresAt in milliseconds while handleRedirect() passes nowSeconds(); isExpired() compares the two, so a link never expires.

defects.anchor: const res = await fetch(target, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(3000) });
defects.title: Link preview fetches arbitrary internal URLs
defects.description: fetchPreview() requests any submitted URL from the server, including loopback and private addresses, and returns the first 200 bytes of the response.
defects.observed: 201 with a preview snippet containing the internal service's response body.

defects.title: Stats for an unknown code dereference undefined
defects.description: linkStats() casts the Map lookup to Link and reads its fields without handling a missing code.
